deities: Lord Narasimha (Narsingh Dev, fourth avatar of Vishnu, presiding deity)
festivals: Kartik Purnima Mela (per devotee reviews - the temple's main fair)

history.period: About 600 years old per devotee reviews (unverified)
history.summary: A Narsimha (Narasimha) temple at Morangi, about 6 km from Hazaribagh town, just outside the township (per Justdial listing, 4.5/390 ratings; devotee reviews). A reviewer describes it as a very old temple of Shri Nrisingh Dev, about 600 years old, with regular worship of Lord Nrisingh; devotees also mention nine avatars of Vishnu depicted and some reference Maa Durga worship (verify). It is noted as a calm, spiritual place famous for the Kartik Purnima mela, with food huts nearby. Opening hours per a devotee review: 8:00 AM-1:00 PM and 3:00 PM-6:00 PM (verify). FLAG - LOCATION CONFLICT: Justdial lists it at Morangi, Hazaribagh, while the geocoder matched 'Narsingh Sthan Road' in Azad Mohalla, Hazaribagh - the two may be the same shrine or different ones; coordinates are approximate (verify on the ground).

name: Narsingh Sthan Temple
town: Hazaribagh (temple is at Morangi, ~6 km outside Hazaribagh town)
town_description: Hazaribagh is the headquarters of Hazaribagh district in Jharkhand, a plateau town known for its lakes, wildlife sanctuary, and pilgrimage sites including Surajkund and Rajrappa. Morangi is a locality on the outskirts of the town.

travel.airport: Birsa Munda Airport, Ranchi is the nearest major airport (~90-100 km - verify).
travel.railway: Hazaribagh Town station is the nearest railhead (verify); Koderma Junction is the nearest major junction.
travel.road: About 6 km from Hazaribagh town at Morangi; reachable by taxi or three-wheeler/auto-rickshaw from the town (per devotee reviews - verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather; Kartik Purnima (October-November) for the mela.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 8:00 AM-1:00 PM and 3:00 PM-6:00 PM (per a devotee review - verify).
